title: Debate on Urban Mobility
summary: Two residents debate bike lanes, buses, and priorities for a growing city.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.pt: A cidade não pode continuar dependendo tanto de carros. Se houvesse mais ciclovias, muita gente deixaria o carro em casa.
lines.en: The city cannot keep depending so much on cars. If there were more bike lanes, many people would leave the car at home.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Concordo em parte, mas nem todos moram perto do trabalho. Antes de investir só em ciclovias, precisamos melhorar os ônibus.
lines.en: I partly agree, but not everyone lives near work. Before investing only in bike lanes, we need to improve the buses.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.pt: Claro, o transporte público deve ser prioridade. Porém, uma coisa não exclui a outra.
lines.en: Of course, public transportation should be a priority. However, one thing does not exclude the other.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Meu receio é que façam obras bonitas no centro e esqueçam os bairros mais afastados.
lines.en: My fear is that they will build nice projects downtown and forget the more distant neighborhoods.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.pt: Por isso a participação dos moradores é essencial. A prefeitura deveria ouvir quem pega ônibus lotado todos os dias.
lines.en: That is why resident participation is essential. City hall should listen to those who take crowded buses every day.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Se o plano incluísse tarifa justa, corredores de ônibus e ciclovias seguras, eu apoiaria sem dúvida.
lines.en: If the plan included fair fares, bus lanes, and safe bike lanes, I would support it without a doubt.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.pt: Então estamos mais próximos do que parecia. O problema não é escolher entre ônibus e bicicleta, mas planejar com seriedade.
lines.en: Then we are closer than it seemed. The problem is not choosing between buses and bicycles, but planning seriously.

comprehension.question: What does Helena believe more bike lanes would do?
options: Encourage people to leave cars at home
comprehension.answer: Encourage people to leave cars at home

comprehension.question: What is Marcos worried about?
options: The city has too many parks

comprehension.question: What would make Marcos support the plan?
options: Fair fares, bus lanes, and safe bike lanes
comprehension.answer: Fair fares, bus lanes, and safe bike lanes

comprehension.question: What conclusion do they reach?
options: The city needs serious integrated planning
comprehension.answer: The city needs serious integrated planning
